name: Apartametul afit
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The apartments for self-catering are located in Lienz, the main town of East Tyrol. The holiday apartments are designed for self-sufficient guests. Each apartment features a kitchenette and a living area. Lienz serves as a starting point for hiking and cultural exploration. The historic old town is easily accessible on foot. Surrounding the area offers scenic walking and cycling trails. This accommodation is ideal for a self-contained stay.
